description: The Organic Meat Company Limited is a Pakistani meat processor and exporter. Its processing plant in Karachi supplies fresh meat to customers abroad, and the business is built on animal by-products that it processes for export.
headOffice: Plot No. 257, Sector 24, Korangi Industrial Area, Karachi, Pakistan
sourceNote: Company website (tomcl.net: home, CEO interview, contact), read 2026-10-17. The registered address the company lists is Survey No. 310, Deh Shah Mureed, Gadap, Karachi; the address given here is its published corporate office.

products.name: Fresh and frozen meat
products.summary: Tender, fresh meat processed at the company's Karachi plant for export customers.

products.name: Animal by-products
products.summary: By-products processed for export, which the company's chief executive describes as the basis of its foreign-exchange earning.
